verdict.rationale: Devin's own repository indexing powers 'Ask Devin' and DeepWiki, which let users explore and query their codebase. Devin Review also flags bugs, which amounts to AI-generated suggestions on the user's code. This is in-product insight over the user's code data, but the evidence only names these features and does not describe what insights they actually produce. missing for 10: detailed documentation of Ask Devin/DeepWiki insight and suggestion outputs, any insights from non-code data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Indexing your repositories allows Devin to understand your codebase and enables powerful features like Ask Devin and DeepWiki.
These tools let you explore and query documentation for any GitHub repository (public or private with authentication)
Enable Devin Review with Auto-Fix so Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
